argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
It is interesting to contemplate an entangled bank, clothed with many plants of many kinds, with birds singing on the bushes, with various insects flitting about, and with worms crawling through the damp earth, and to reflect that these elaborately constructed forms, so different from each other, and dependent on each other in so complex a manner, have all been produced by laws acting around us. These laws, taken in the largest sense, being Growth with Reproduction; Inheritance which is almost implied by reproduction; Variability from the indirect and direct action of the external conditions of life, and from use and disuse; a Ratio of Increase so high as to lead to a Struggle for Life, and as a consequence to Natural Selection, entailing Divergence of Character and the Extinction of less-improved forms. Thus, from the war of nature, from famine and death, the most exalted object which we are capable of conceiving, namely, the production of the higher animals, directly follows. There is grandeur in this view of life, with its several powers, having been originally breathed into a few forms or into one; and that, whilst this planet has gone cycling on according to the fixed law of gravity, from so simple a beginning endless forms most beautiful and most wonderful have been, and are being, evolved.
</passage>

response.text:
It could, perhaps, be considered a value-add exercise to engage in the contemplation of a multi-stakeholder ecosystem of biotic assets—an entangled bank, as it were—characterized by a diverse portfolio of plant-based deliverables, avian vocalization outputs, insect-driven mobility events, and subterranean annelid activity, all operating within a shared operational environment; and, without wishing to overstate the case, some consideration might be given to the notion that these elaborately architected form-factors, notwithstanding their apparent heterogeneity, and notwithstanding their mutual interdependencies within what could arguably be described as a highly complex value chain, may—to whatever extent such attribution is ultimately deemed appropriate—have been generated through the operationalization of certain law-based frameworks presently leveraged in the surrounding ecosystem.

These frameworks, understood at the broadest level of abstraction (though this framing is offered with all appropriate caveats), might be said to encompass: Growth, in conjunction with Reproduction-related throughput; Inheritance, which is arguably, though not without some interpretive latitude, a near-automatic implication of reproductive activity; Variability, attributable, in some non-trivial but not fully quantifiable measure, to both direct and indirect environmental input-factors as well as to patterns of utilization and non-utilization; an Increase Ratio of such magnitude as to potentially necessitate a Struggle-for-Life dynamic, giving rise, as a downstream consequence, to a Natural Selection mechanism, which in turn may entail Character Divergence and the Extinction-related attrition of comparatively under-optimized form-factors.

It could therefore be tentatively proposed, subject to further validation, that from this ongoing competitive dynamic within the natural ecosystem—characterized, not unreasonably, by scarcity-driven and mortality-adjacent conditions—there emerges, at scale, what might be regarded as among the more elevated conceptual outputs achievable by human cognition: namely, the generation of higher-order faunal entities.

There exists, arguably, a certain grandeur-adjacent quality inherent to this particular framing of the life-process, insofar as its several constituent capacities are understood to have been, at some initial juncture, imparted—whether into a limited set of foundational form-factors or into a singular such form-factor remains, admittedly, somewhat outside the scope of full alignment—and insofar as this planetary system, having continued its cyclical trajectory in accordance with a fixed gravitational-law framework, is understood to have facilitated the ongoing evolution, from so minimal an initial-state input, of an effectively open-ended array of form-factors, each characterized, to a greater or lesser and not fully specifiable degree, by attributes of beauty and wonder.
